intro: Bartleby's Mug is the concluding task in a young Stormwind warrior's initial test of grit. Having bested the belligerent brawler Bartleby in the Pig and Whistle Tavern, the adventurer claims his drinking mug as proof of victory for their trainer, Harry Burlguard.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ok, here's my mug. Wait! Let me finish what's in it first... There we go.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I saw your fight with Bartleby. Nicely done! Did you get his mug?

clips.title: Completion
paras: There it is! He sure didn't want to part with it, but you were persuasive. Well done.
